author: Sabine Hossenfelder
description:
Want to restore the planet’s ecosystems and see your impact in monthly videos? The first 100 people to join Planet Wild with my code SABINE310 will get the first month paid for by me: https://planetwild.com/r/sabinehossenfelder/join/310
If you want to get to know them better first, check out their floating wetland mission: https://planetwild.com/r/sabinehossenfelder/m43/310

We’ve been told for decades that a plastic bottle lasts 450 years, or even that plastic never goes away. But how would anyone know, given that plastic has only been widely used for about a century? Recent research tells a different story, and it’s both better and worse. Let’s take a look.
